**Content boundaries respected:** no prices, opening hours, credentials or testimonials invented; nothing about motor vehicles or medical advice. The article covers only the preparation task (describing when air loss occurs, what to bring) and does not restate repair steps or claim services beyond "repair punctures and inspect tires".
